subject: Tamil Nadu electricity tax rates and exemptions
text: Tamil Nadu. Electricity tax under the Tax on Consumption or Sale of Electricity Act, 2003: 5% of the consumption charge on electricity sold by the licensee (TNPDCL) to consumers, collected by TNPDCL; 5% of the consumption charge on surplus electricity sold by captive or independent power plants to third parties; 10 paise per unit on electricity consumed from one's own captive plant or standby generator (DG set) and on power bought through the Indian Energy Exchange. Exempt: electricity sold for agriculture and to hut connections, electricity sold to domestic consumers by TNPDCL, electricity sold to the government, local authorities and the railways, sales to TNPDCL, and exemptions under state policies such as the Industrial Policy 2021 and E-Vehicle Policy 2019. The Act allows 5% to 10% for licensees.

text: Tamil Nadu. Enterprises in the listed thrust sectors, new or taking up substantial expansion, anywhere in the state: 25% on eligible plant and machinery, maximum Rs.150 lakh.

source.doc: Tamil Nadu Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department Policy Note 2026-27

subject: Tamil Nadu MSME back-ended interest subsidy
text: Tamil Nadu. Back-ended interest subsidy: 5% for 5 years on term loans up to Rs.200 lakh under CGTMSE, ceiling Rs.20 lakh; 5% for 5 years on term loans up to Rs.500 lakh under the Technology Upgradation Fund, ceiling Rs.25 lakh.

source.doc: Tamil Nadu Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department Policy Note 2026-27

subject: Tamil Nadu artisans self-employment subsidy
text: Tamil Nadu. Scheme for artisans of 25 identified trades, minimum age 35: project cost up to Rs.3 lakh, subsidy of 25% of the project cost up to Rs.50,000, and interest subsidy of 2% on loans through TAICO Bank or 5% through other banks.

source.doc: Tamil Nadu Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department Policy Note 2026-27

subject: Andhra Pradesh electricity duty rate range
text: Andhra Pradesh. Electricity duty: from 1 December 1993 the duty was 6 paise per unit. G.O.Ms.No.7 of 8 April 2022 set higher rates, but the High Court in 2025 struck it down and held that 6 paise per unit could be collected until the rate was lawfully changed by G.O.Ms.No.22 of 23 October 2023 (not held); a Special Leave Petition against that is pending in the Supreme Court. Ordinance No.8 of 2025 (1 December 2025) and L.A. Bill No.3 of 2026 (introduced 13 February 2026) validate past collections and put a range of 6 paise to Re.1 per unit in the Act, the rate per consumer category to be set by notification. Exemptions may be granted under section 3A of the Act. The rate notified now for each category, and whether the Bill has passed, are not held.

source.doc: Andhra Pradesh Electricity Duty (Amendment) Ordinance No.8 of 2025, and L.A. Bill No.3 of 2026

subject: Tamil Nadu state pension schemes eligibility
text: Tamil Nadu. State-funded pensions, who can get them. Differently abled: 18 or above, 40% disability or more, unemployed or, if self or privately employed, annual income up to Rs.3 lakh. Destitute widow: 18 or above, fixed assets up to Rs.1 lakh. CM Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam old age: destitute landless agricultural labourer, 60 or above, assets up to Rs.1 lakh. Destitute or deserted wife: 30 or above, legally divorced, deserted for at least 5 years, or with a court separation certificate, assets up to Rs.1 lakh. Poor unmarried women: 50 or above, assets up to Rs.1 lakh. A free government house is not counted as an asset.

source.doc: Tamil Nadu Revenue and Disaster Management Department Policy Note 2026-27

subject: Tamil Nadu unemployment assistance
text: Tamil Nadu. Unemployment assistance: unemployed youth on the Employment Exchange live register for at least five years, within the income and age limits, get Rs.200 to Rs.600 a month by educational qualification, for up to three years. Differently abled registrants on the live register for at least one year get Rs.600 to Rs.1,000 a month by qualification.

source.doc: Tamil Nadu Labour Welfare and Skill Development Department Policy Note 2026-27, section 4.14

subject: Andhra Pradesh DEEPAM-2 free LPG cylinders
text: Andhra Pradesh. DEEPAM-2: 3 free LPG cylinder refills a year for eligible households, from 31.10.2024, one in each block period: April to July, August to November, December to March. The subsidy is credited through the oil companies. Tribal families with 5 kg cylinders get a free 14.2 kg connection, the government paying the security deposit and documentation charges (G.O.Ms.No.22 of 08.09.2025). Who is eligible is set by G.O.Ms.No.12 of 25.10.2024, which is not held.

source.doc: G.O.Rt.No.25 CA,F&CS (CS.I) Dt.01.05.2025 - DEEPAM-2 guidelines, and G.O.Ms.No.22 Dt.08.09.2025

subject: Andhra Pradesh PNG subvention for piped gas
text: Andhra Pradesh PNG Subvention Scheme: Rs.2,400 a year per domestic piped natural gas connection, for households eligible under DEEPAM-2, paid by DBT in six instalments with the bi-monthly gas bill, only after the LPG connection is surrendered; LPG and PNG subsidy are not both allowed. Aadhaar-linked bank account needed. A household that gets PNG must, within 30 days, end its LPG connection or take a transfer voucher.

source.doc: G.O.Ms.No.3 CA,F&CS (CS-I) Dt.10.04.2026, and operational guidelines G.O.Ms.No.11 Dt.31.07.2026

subject: Andhra Pradesh NTR Bharosa pension eligibility
text: Andhra Pradesh, NTR Bharosa pensions, who can get them. For all: a BPL family with a white ration card, a local resident of the district, not covered by another pension. Old age: 60 or above and destitute. Widow: 18 or above. Disabled: at least 40% disability, no age limit. Weavers, toddy tappers, fishermen, dappu artists: 50 or above. Traditional cobblers: above 40. Transgender: 18 or above. ART (PLHIV): 6 months' continuous ART, no age limit. CKDU on dialysis: no age limit. Single women: separated or deserted married women above 35, separated for over a year; unmarried women 30 or above in rural areas, 35 or above in urban areas, with no family support. Not eligible: government or PSU employees and pensioners, income tax payers, owners of more than 2.5 acres wet or 5 acres dry (or 5 acres together; except ST in ITDA scheduled areas), outsourced and monthly salaried private employees, car owners, freedom fighter pensioners. Sanctioned by the MPDO (rural) or Municipal Commissioner (urban). The amounts on this page are old; current amounts are in G.O.Ms.No.43 of 13.06.2024.

source.doc: NTR Bharosa Pension Scheme portal, SERP, Government of Andhra Pradesh: eligibility criteria

subject: Tamil Nadu rural employment guarantee wage rate 2026-27
text: Tamil Nadu. Rural employment scheme VB-GRAM (G), which follows MGNREGS, 2026-27: wage of Rs.345 a day for unskilled workers, paid by Aadhaar-based DBT into the worker's bank account; attendance by face authentication on the NMMS app.

source.doc: Tamil Nadu Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department Policy Note 2026-27, section 5.8

subject: Andhra Pradesh housing scheme unit cost PMAY
text: Andhra Pradesh, housing. PMAY (Gramin) 2.0, 2026-27 to 2028-29: unit cost Rs.2.39 lakh per house, made up of Rs.1.20 lakh assistance (Rs.72,000 central, Rs.48,000 state), an SHG loan of Rs.80,000 at 3% interest with the interest reimbursed by the government, Rs.27,000 as 90 days' wages under G RAM G, and Rs.12,000 for a toilet (G.O.Rt.No.20 of 16.03.2026). Houses sanctioned under PMAY (U) BLC 1.0, PMAY (Gramin) 1.0 and PM JANMAN and still under construction get extra help of Rs.50,000 for SC and all BC, Rs.75,000 for ST and Rs.1 lakh for PVTG beneficiaries (G.O.Rt.No.9 of 10.03.2025). PMAY (Urban) BLC: central assistance of Rs.1.50 lakh to EWS families; BLC 2.0 at an enhanced unit cost of Rs.2.50 lakh. House site pattas of 3 cents in rural and 2 cents in urban areas for eligible families with no pucca house or site.

source.doc: G.O.Rt.No.20 Housing (R&UH.A2) Dt.16.03.2026 - PMAY-G 2.0 unit cost; G.O.Rt.No.9 Dt.10.03.2025; Outcome and Gender Budgets 2026-27

subject: Andhra Pradesh Thalliki Vandanam mother's education assistance
text: Andhra Pradesh. Thalliki Vandanam: Rs.15,000 a year paid to the mother for each child studying from Class I to Intermediate, for SC, ST, BC, minority and EWS families (2026-27). Eligibility conditions are not in this document.

source.doc: Andhra Pradesh Gender Budget 2026-27

subject: Andhra Pradesh vehicle transfer of ownership documents and RC renewal late fee
text: Andhra Pradesh, Transport Department (citizen charter of August 2022). Transfer of ownership of a vehicle: Form 29 in duplicate, Form 30 (in duplicate, signed by the financier if under finance), residence proof, original RC, valid insurance, valid PUC, NOC if the vehicle is from another state, and a clearance certificate if registered at another AP office; apply at the unit office or RTO. On the owner's death: Form 31, death certificate, affidavit or NOC from all legal heirs on Rs.10 stamp paper attested by a notary, original RC, insurance, PUC and residence proof. Late renewal of a non-transport vehicle's RC: Rs.300 a month for motorcycles and Rs.500 a month for other vehicles; smart card RC Rs.200 extra. The tax on transferring a used vehicle is not in this document.

source.doc: Andhra Pradesh Transport Department Citizen's Charter, August 2022

subject: Tamil Nadu Magalir Urimai Thittam Rs.1,000 a month for women
text: Tamil Nadu. Magalir Urimai Thittam: Rs.1,000 a month credited to the woman head of an eligible family, since September 2023 (about 1.31 crore women now). Family conditions: annual income below Rs.2.5 lakh; less than 5 acres wet or 10 acres dry land; less than 3,600 units of domestic electricity a year. Women in families receiving social security pensions (widow, destitute, deserted, unmarried women, old age, CM Farmers' Security Scheme, disability) may apply if they are not pensioners themselves; so may families of special time scale pensioners and families owning a four-wheeler bought under a government subsidy scheme. Other exclusions apply.

source.doc: Tamil Nadu Special Programme Implementation Department Policy Note 2026-27, Magalir Urimai Thittam

subject: Tamil Nadu Pudhumai Penn and Tamil Pudhalvan Rs.1,000 a month for students
text: Tamil Nadu. Pudhumai Penn (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assistance): Rs.1,000 a month to girl students in higher education who studied Class VI to XII in government or government-aided schools in Tamil medium; no family income limit. Tamil Pudhalvan: the same Rs.1,000 a month for boys on the same conditions.

subject: Tamil Nadu girl child protection scheme deposit
text: Tamil Nadu. Girl Child Protection Scheme: Rs.50,000 deposited in the name of the child for a family with only one girl child, or Rs.25,000 each for a family with two girl children; the maturity amount is paid when the girl reaches 18 and completes high school.

source.doc: Tamil Nadu Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department Policy Note 2026-27, section 1.2.1

subject: Andhra Pradesh market value (guideline value) lookup and objections
text: Andhra Pradesh. The market value (basic value) used for stamp duty is looked up on the IGRS site, registration.ap.gov.in, under Market Value Assistance or Property Value, by district and Sub-Registrar office: urban locality-wise rates (Form 1), urban door-number-wise rates (Form 2), rural village-wise rates (Form 3) and rural survey-number-wise rates (Form 4). As of 6 November 2026 the site also shows proposed revised market values in the same four forms; objections or suggestions go to the concerned Sub-Registrar or through the online Grievance link. The date the revision takes effect is not on that page. Use the site's Duty and Fee calculator for the charges. VETRA does not hold the rates themselves.

text: Andhra Pradesh Registration and Stamps Department: help desk 14544; to report a demand for a bribe, 14400. Complaints can also be lodged online through the Grievance link on registration.ap.gov.in, and citizens can book a slot and prepare their own document through Public Data Entry (PDE).

subject: Tamil Nadu electricity tax on own generators (self-generation)
text: Tamil Nadu. Electricity tax on electricity a person generates and consumes from their own generator (anyone other than a licensee or the State): 10 paise per unit consumed. Register the generator with the Electrical Inspector (Electricity Tax Inspecting Officer) in Form A1 within 7 days of purchase, with a fee of Rs.2,000 up to 500 kVA, Rs.4,000 above 500 up to 2,500 kVA, Rs.8,000 above 2,500 kVA (G.O.Ms.No.47, Energy (D2), 12.07.2023), paid by e-challan on karuvoolam.tn.gov.in; certificate in Form A2 within 30 days. Pay the tax for each month within 30 days and file the monthly return in Form C2 online at tnei.tn.gov.in; late payment carries 12% a year interest.

subject: Tamil Nadu guideline value lookup and free encumbrance certificate
text: Tamil Nadu. Guideline values are searched on tnreginet.gov.in (Guideline Value Search) by street or by survey number: choose the district, Sub-Registrar office, village and street; values from 2002 onwards can be viewed. The same portal gives a free view and download of encumbrance certificate details, finds which Sub-Registrar office has jurisdiction over a street or village, and handles document, marriage, society, firm and chit registration and certified copies online. Software help: 1800 102 5174. VETRA does not hold the guideline values themselves.

subject: Andhra Pradesh free power to hair cutting saloons
text: Andhra Pradesh. Hair cutting saloons (Nayee Brahmin community) get free electricity up to 200 units a month, raised from 150 units, with the BC Welfare Department paying the cost.

text: Andhra Pradesh. Free electricity: SC households up to 200 units a month (about 16.44 lakh households); ST households have their electricity charges reimbursed (free power, about 5 lakh households). From 1 April 2026, handloom weavers get free power up to 200 units a month and power loom weavers up to 500 units a month. Hair cutting saloons get up to 200 units (G.O.Ms.No.69 of 2025).

text: Tamil Nadu. No-cost electricity for domestic consumers from 10.05.2026: households using up to 500 units in a two-month billing cycle get the first 200 units free; households using more than 500 units get 100 units free. About 2.23 crore domestic consumers benefit; the government pays TNPDCL as tariff subsidy. Domestic consumption is also exempt from electricity tax.

text: Andhra Pradesh. Schemes renamed by G.O.Ms.No.04, Social Welfare (Edu.I), 18.06.2024, pending review of their provisions: Jagananna Vidya Deevena is now Post Matric Scholarships (RTF); Jagananna Vasathi Deevena is Post Matric Scholarships (MTF); Jagananna Videshi Vidya Deevena (for SCs) is Ambedkar Overseas Vidya Nidhi (AOVN); YSR Kalyana Masthu is Chandranna Pelli Kanuka; YSR Vidyonnathi is NTR Vidyonnathi; Jagananna Civil Services Protsahakam is Incentives for Civil Services Examination. subject: Andhra Pradesh SC Corporation self-employment units with bank loans 2025-26
text: Andhra Pradesh, SC Corporation economic support schemes with bank finance, 2025-26 (G.O.Ms.No.5, Social Welfare (SCP), 01.04.2025, in Telugu). Units up to Rs.3 lakh (industry, services and business): subsidy 60%, bank loan 35%, beneficiary 5%. Units above Rs.3 lakh, including those above Rs.10 lakh such as passenger autos, cars and battery charging units: subsidy 40%, bank loan 55%, beneficiary 5%. Agriculture drones for groups of five: subsidy 40%, loan 55%, beneficiary 5%. Steps: register on the OBMMS portal; the mandal or municipal selection committee finalises the list within 48 hours; biometric authentication at the MPDO or Municipal Commissioner office; the bank checks the applicant is not a defaulter and opens a savings account and a zero-balance loan account; the subsidy is released by the SC Corporation as back-ended subsidy and adjusted to the loan after two years once the unit is verified again. Subsidy ceilings in the table were not readable in the scan.

source.doc: G.O.Ms.No.5 Social Welfare (SCP) Dt.01.04.2025 - SC action plan 2025-26, economic support schemes with bank finance (Telugu), read by OCR

subject: Tamil Nadu cooperative loans for widows, deserted women, transgender persons and the differently abled
text: Tamil Nadu cooperative credit institutions, 2026-27: loans to destitute widows and deserted women, and to transgender persons, at a concessional 5% interest. Differently abled borrowers who repay on time get full interest subsidy. Also offered: SHG loans, women entrepreneur and working women loans, education loans for students from poor families, and loans to landless poor women agricultural labourers to buy farm land; 20% of KCC crop and animal husbandry loans is earmarked for SC/ST farmers. Loan limits are not in this document.

source.doc: Tamil Nadu Co-operation Department Policy Note 2026-27, section 2.13

subject: Andhra Pradesh registration office service time limits (citizen charter)
text: Andhra Pradesh Registration and Stamps Department citizen charter (G.O.Rt.No.1094, Revenue (Registration.I), 12.07.2013): registered document scanned, certified and returned within 24 hours (Sub-Registrar; penalty Rs.50 a day of delay); encumbrance certificate or certified copy from computer records within 1 hour (Rs.10 an hour), from manual records within 24 hours (Rs.50 a day); marriage registration certificate within 1 hour; market value slip within 1 hour; a document held for undervaluation (section 47-A) referred to the District Registrar within 7 days after the Sub-Registrar visits the property; registration of societies and firms within 3 days at the District Registrar. This charter dates from 2013; the current timelines may differ.

source.doc: G.O.Rt.No.1094 Revenue (Registration.I) Dt.12.07.2013 - revised Citizens Charter of the Registration Department, as hosted on registration.ap.gov.in

subject: GST rates, composition scheme and registration (all states)
text: GST, as described by the Tamil Nadu Commercial Taxes Department for 2026-27: State and Central GST on supplies within a state, Integrated GST on inter-state supplies and imports. Two main rates, 18% standard and 5% merit; 40% on specified de-merit goods and services; 3% on gold, silver, platinum and pearls; 0.25% on rough diamonds and precious stones. Services generally 18%. Composition scheme: turnover up to Rs.1.5 crore in the previous year pays 1% or 5% by type of business; service providers up to Rs.50 lakh pay 6%. Registration is needed above a threshold turnover (the note refers to a Rs.20 lakh threshold; the threshold for goods is not stated); an optional simplified registration, granted automatically within three working days for small, low-risk applicants who pass on input tax credit of no more than Rs.2.5 lakh a month, runs from 01.11.2025. e-Invoices are required above Rs.5 crore turnover.

source.doc: Tamil Nadu Commercial Taxes Department Policy Note 2026-27, section 7.9

subject: Chennai (Greater Chennai Corporation) property tax revision 2022
text: Tamil Nadu, Greater Chennai Corporation property tax, general revision from the first half of 2022-23 (under G.O.(Ms) No.53, MAWS, 30.03.2022, and Council Resolution No.39/2022). The old Basic Street Rate is multiplied by an increase factor, core city and added areas: residential up to 600 sq.ft 1.5 and 1.25; 601 to 1,200 sq.ft 1.75 and 1.5; 1,201 to 1,800 sq.ft 2 and 1.75; above 1,800 sq.ft 2.5 and 2; industry 2 and 1.75; commercial (also hotels, kalyana mandapams, hospitals, cinemas) 2.5 and 2; private schools and colleges 2 and 1.75. Property tax is 12.40% of annual value per half year (the floor rate). Vacant land tax Rs.1 per sq.ft (was Rs.0.50). Age rebate: buildings assessed up to March 1997 10%, April 1997 to March 2007 6%, April 2007 to March 2017 3%, from April 2017 nil. Each year from 1 April the Basic Street Rate rises by 6% or the 5-year average GSDP growth, whichever is higher. This notice invited objections within 30 days before the council finalised it; the final council resolution is not held. The street rate for a locality is not in this notice. Other municipalities are not covered here.

source.doc: Tamil Nadu Government Gazette Extraordinary No.218, Part III Section 2, 11.04.2022: Greater Chennai Corporation notification for general revision of property tax
